name: Identify 'Whale' customers in Switzerland (99th percentile spend).
python_code:
# Filter for Switzerland customers
switzerland_df = df[df['Country'] == 'Switzerland'].copy()

# Calculate total spend per customer (Price * Quantity)
switzerland_df['TotalSpend'] = switzerland_df['Price'] * switzerland_df['Quantity']

# Aggregate total spend per customer
customer_spend = switzerland_df.groupby('Customer ID')['TotalSpend'].sum().reset_index()
customer_spend.columns = ['Customer ID', 'TotalSpend']

# Calculate the 99th percentile threshold
threshold = customer_spend['TotalSpend'].quantile(0.99)

# Identify whale customers (above 99th percentile)
whale_customers = customer_spend[customer_spend['TotalSpend'] > threshold].copy()

# Store result with customer IDs and their total spend
result = whale_customers
